text:
Petrol burns in a car engine to produce waste gases which leave through the car exhaust.
One of these waste gases is an oxide of nitrogen.
Which statement describes how this oxide of nitrogen is formed?
A
Carbon dioxide reacts with nitrogen in the catalytic converter.
B
Nitrogen reacts with oxygen in the car engine.
C
Nitrogen reacts with oxygen in the catalytic converter.
D
Petrol combines with nitrogen in the car engine.

options.label: A
options.text: Carbon dioxide reacts with nitrogen in the catalytic converter.

options.label: B
options.text: Nitrogen reacts with oxygen in the car engine.

options.label: C
options.text: Nitrogen reacts with oxygen in the catalytic converter.

options.label: D
options.text: Petrol combines with nitrogen in the car engine.
